title: Guardana Recording v2
description: One record of a Guardana recording: what an application answered, graded later without calling it. The file is JSONL: the first non-blank line is the header, every later non-blank line is one exchange. Each line validates against this schema independently; that the header comes first, that an exchange names a rule when the header names no default, and that a file holds at least one exchange are checked by the reader.

header.description: The first record. `verbatim` has no default: the producer states whether every reply is exactly what the application said, and a reply that may not be is never graded.

subject.description: What answered, as the producer names it.

subject_kind.description: What answered, as the producer declares it: the endpoint the team's users reach (`application`), or a model reached without the application's prompt, tools and data (`model_harness`). A recipe grading the recording takes it as the run's kind when the recipe declares none.

rule.description: The rule id of every exchange that names none.

origin.description: The probe run the recording was kept from, as that run declared it. Written by `guardana probe --keep-exchanges`; declared, not verified.

trials.description: The trials per case each rule ran with.

rules.description: Every rule the run's plain pass planned, reached or not.

exchange.description: One exchange: the messages a rule sent and the reply the application gave.

input.description: One user message as a string, or the messages in order; the last must be from the user, which the reader checks.

reply.description: What the application answered; may be empty.

key.description: The digest of the messages as the rule sent them, taken before any redaction.

altered.description: True when the reply is not exactly what the application said.
